supported_extensibility.component: Mesh data model and ShapeNet operator
supported_extensibility.finding: Mesh stores separate z,dz,layer arrays. ShapeNet accepts Mesh, not ValidationMesh, and uses actual dz[k] for XY conductance/side-face area, half distances for Z harmonic conductance and top-contact series depth. No algebraic uniform-dz assumption was found in the inherited network, resistance, loss, field or shared-flux interface formulas.
supported_extensibility.implication: A separately registered explicit-face Mesh subclass can reuse unchanged ShapeNet and COCG. This is source feasibility, not proof of stability or convergence on the proposed meshes.

supported_extensibility.finding: sc8_math.native_geometry accepts metadata-driven counts and strictly increasing explicit faces, checks physical tissue interfaces, centers, repeated columns and actual h^2*dz volumes. selectivity_volume.native_region_weights also checks the exact finite-cylinder XY mask and derives fractional target XY/exact-depth-overlap weights from actual faces, without analytical volume renormalization.
supported_extensibility.implication: These pure kernels support U19/G18 without changing ROI or statistic definitions. Retain both geometry checks; native_geometry alone does not independently enumerate the true cylinder XY membership.

supported_extensibility.finding: sc8_interfaces uses actual sample depths with two/three-node Lagrange extrapolation and a conditioning guard. It does not assume uniform z spacing or use stored E/shared currents.
supported_extensibility.implication: Retain fixed2/2 and3/3 fits on both reference and candidate, all three interfaces and identical physical interior/periphery scopes. Add graded-node analytic and conditioning fixtures before native execution.

supported_extensibility.component: Native field reconstruction and weighted statistics
supported_extensibility.finding: sc8_math.reconstruct_native_field derives each half-face distance from actual dz and weighted_statistics uses actual volume weights.
supported_extensibility.implication: Reusable as ABI self-consistency and integration; reconstructed gamma*E or phi-to-E agreement is not independent physical accuracy validation.
